configuration.system_prompt: These are quarterly financial statements with one column per quarter. Return one entry in quarters per quarterly column. Copy every amount exactly as printed; never calculate, total or estimate a value.

note: Raw LlamaExtract output. Values are not confirmed; confirm each one on /statements before it is used.

citation_summary.message: 60 of 96 values have a page location but no quoted text
citation_summary.known_limitation: With the pinned configuration (tier agentic, version 2.5), LlamaExtract returns many citations as a page and bounding box with the field path in place of quoted text. Such a value is shown as "Located on page N (no quoted text)" and can be confirmed only if it passes a tie-out (balance sheet, operating income, printed total debt or EBITDA, or the CSV match).
